coding.title: Mean Imputation (Missing Values)
coding.description:
Given a list containing numerical values with missing values represented by None, replace every missing value with the mean of the available values.

Read comma-separated tokens from stdin. An empty token or NONE means missing. Print comma-separated values with each missing token replaced by the mean of the numeric values (use one decimal place when needed).
coding.starterCode:
import sys

tokens = [t.strip() for t in sys.stdin.read().strip().split(',')]
values = [float(t) for t in tokens if t and t.upper() != 'NONE']
mean = sum(values) / len(values)
result = []
for t in tokens:
    if not t or t.upper() == 'NONE':
        result.append(f'{mean:.1f}' if mean % 1 else str(int(mean)))
    else:
        result.append(t)
print(','.join(result))

coding.title: Student Performance Summary
coding.description:
Given student data containing Name, Marks, and Study Hours: (1) calculate average marks, (2) find the highest scorer, (3) find students scoring 75 or above, and (4) calculate the average marks of students who studied more than 5 hours.

Read a JSON array of students from stdin (fields: name, marks, hours). Print exactly four lines:
Average Marks: <value>
Highest Scorer: <name>
Students scoring 75 or above: <comma-separated names>
Average Marks of students studying more than 5 hours: <value rounded to 2 decimals>
coding.starterCode:
import sys, json

students = json.loads(sys.stdin.read().strip())
avg = sum(s['marks'] for s in students) / len(students)
print(f"Average Marks: {avg}")
highest = max(students, key=lambda s: s['marks'])
print(f"Highest Scorer: {highest['name']}")
qualified = [s['name'] for s in students if s['marks'] >= 75]
print("Students scoring 75 or above: " + ", ".join(qualified))
high = [s['marks'] for s in students if s['hours'] > 5]
print(f"Average Marks of students studying more than 5 hours: {round(sum(high)/len(high), 2)}")

publicTestCases.expectedOutput:
Average Marks: 78.8
Highest Scorer: Arjun
Students scoring 75 or above: Rahul, Arjun, Kiran
Average Marks of students studying more than 5 hours: 84.67

Highest Scorer: B
Students scoring 75 or above: A, B, C
Average Marks of students studying more than 5 hours: 83.0
